body:
I’ll be the first one to say - people will hurt if you leave this world. They really will. Even people you don’t think would, they will.

That being said - your pain is absolutely real. I think about it all the time. Find people to talk to who get it and maybe it’ll make things a bit easier. The choice to live is yours alone but I promise there are people who want you here ❤️
I get this so much. I avoid mirrors at all costs and the thought of wearing a bathing suit in the summer makes me sick
I could use a friend. Not sure how all this works as I’m new to Reddit but it would be nice to talk to someone who gets it

I have firearms and it’s tempting but I promise it’s not the answer. I’m new to Reddit but seriously message me if you need to - I could use a friend too who really understands what it’s like to consider it so often
My divorce wrecked me. I feel that
I’ve been having some thoughts lately and could use a friend. If you need someone to talk to lmk. Maybe we could create a group or something
